label: Specimen Disaggregation Tank
description: A high-density polyethylene tank used for the controlled dissolution of carbonate matrix using weak organic acids.

components.function: Allows the player to lift the fossil out of the acid without touching the liquid.
Added to the acid to ensure the chemical only eats the rock, not the bone.

game_mechanics.soak_timer: This is a real-time task. The fossil must soak for 24-48 hours. If left too long, even buffered acid will begin to 'etch' the bone.
